scope: Nine enabled football books: Mozzartbet, MDShop, Admiralbet, Betole, MBet, SportPlus, Premier Kladionica, WWIN, MaxBet. EVLBet is excluded because it is disabled.
method: Operator spot check in the OpenChamber browser on 2026-11-03. No bookmaker credentials were stored and no bet was placed. Re-checked on 2026-11-11 (SR9-1) in the OpenChamber browser panel and in plain headless Chromium against fixtures from that day's scan; each route's proof names which.

manual_ticket_prefill.note: SportPlus has no per-event URL and no ticket query parameter. Its slip is read from localStorage['ticket'] on load; the dashboard offers a copyable script that fetches the current offer, matches the leg by match id/market code/alias, writes one pair with the planned stake, and reloads. It places no bet and is not a ticket-filled link.

proof.method: headless Chromium (plain context, no request blocking)
proof.notes: The fixture page opened (Fudbal / Panama / Panama 1, Sat 14.11 22:00, CD Universitario - Herrera FC, Konačan ishod 1 @ 1.55) and the slip held that one selection with the site's default 0.50 BAM stake. The id is the per-row outcomes[].id of the adapter's own /rest/v2/matches payload (147294305); outcomeId is the type id (1001) and does not fill a slip. Both ids are in the same list response, so the adapter needs no second request. SR9-2 wired the shipped template to it.
